title: 船舶污水處理系統
summary: 用分段水量與污染負荷帳串起船舶污水處理，不用單一去除率替代出水驗證。 在船舶污水處理數位模型室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Connect ship wastewater stages using water and pollutant loads rather than one removal percentage. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ship wastewater digital process laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 均化池與生物槽停留時間：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Equalization/reactor residence times: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 均化池與生物槽停留時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Equalization/reactor residence times and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶污水處理系統」的「均化池與生物槽停留時間」中，理想停留時間為有效容積除體積流率。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：用分段水量與污染負荷帳串起船舶污水處理，不用單一去除率替代出水驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship wastewater-treatment systems, Equalization/reactor residence times examines this mechanism: Ideal residence time is effective volume divided by volumetric flow. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Connect ship wastewater stages using water and pollutant loads rather than one removal percentage.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：有效 V=4 m³，Q=2 m³/h。關係式 τ=V/Q；含單位換算算式 4/2 = 2 h。適用條件：只代表理想平均停留時間；實際流體微團可能有短路、回流或死區。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Effective volume 4 m³ and flow 2 m³/h. Relation τ=V/Q; expression including unit conversion 4/2 = 2 h. Applicability: Ideal mean residence only; actual fluid parcels can experience bypass, recirculation or dead zones.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：把名義容積當有效容積會高估處理時間。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Using nominal instead of effective volume overestimates treatment time. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「均化池與生物槽停留時間」，用合成示蹤曲線比較短路與死區，核對有效容積。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Equalization/reactor residence times, Compare bypass and dead-zone synthetic tracer curves and check effective volume. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
